title: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the variance of the instance
question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state, the variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances on host "blaze8-12" that have a corresponding network info cache record, the overall average of these per-state variances as a benchmark, and categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
),
per_state AS (
  SELECT vm_state, VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS state_variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
)
SELECT
  p.vm_state,
  p.state_variance,
  AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () AS benchmark,
  CASE
    WHEN p.state_variance >= 1.5 * AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN p.state_variance <= 0.5 * AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'
  END AS category
FROM per_state p
ORDER BY p.vm_state

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg

ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_cte AS v JOIN metadata_cte AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state,   SELECT i.vm_state, i.memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
),
per_state AS (
  SELECT vm_state, VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS state_variance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
)
SELECT
  p.vm_state,
  p.state_variance,
  AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () AS benchmark,
  CASE
    WHEN p.state_variance >= 1.5 * AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN p.state_variance <= 0.5 * AVG(p.state_variance) OVER () THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'
  END AS category
FROM per_state p
ORDER BY p.vm_state

WITH per_state AS (
  SELECT 
    i.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS state_variance
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM instance_info_caches iic 
      WHERE iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
    )
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(state_variance) AS avg_variance
  FROM per_state
)
SELECT 
  ps.vm_state,
  ps.state_variance,
  b.avg_variance AS benchmark,
  CASE 
    WHEN ps.state_variance >= b.avg_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN ps.state_variance <= b.avg_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'
  END AS variance_category
FROM per_state ps
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
